help.ledger.tray.title: Tray icon
help.ledger.tray.body: Right-click the WidgetBoard icon in the taskbar to open its menu. Left-click it to show or hide all your widgets.
help.ledger.edit.title: Edit layout
help.ledger.edit.body: Choose Edit layout in the tray menu to arrange your widgets on a grid. Click Done or press Esc when you finish.
help.ledger.move_resize.title: Move and resize
help.ledger.move_resize.body: Drag a widget by its top strip to move it. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize it. Edit layout keeps both in view.
help.ledger.push.title: Widgets make room
help.ledger.push.body: In the grid layout, a widget you drag onto others pushes them aside to make room. Free placement, in Settings, lets widgets overlap instead.
help.ledger.widget_menu.title: Widget menu
help.ledger.widget_menu.body: Right-click a widget to open its menu. It has the widget's own options plus common ones such as Appearance, Hide and Close. Edit layout adds more.
help.ledger.add.title: Add a widget
help.ledger.add.body: In Edit layout, right-click an empty cell and pick a widget type. The tray menu's Add widget works any time and uses the first free spot.
help.ledger.tutorial_tab.title: Tutorial tab
help.ledger.tutorial_tab.body: Settings has a Tutorial tab. It lists every feature by level, from the basics to advanced ones.
help.ledger.guide_tab.title: Guide tab
help.ledger.guide_tab.body: Settings has a Guide tab with one entry for each widget type. Widgets with modes explain each mode.
help.ledger.hide.title: Hide a widget
help.ledger.hide.body: Hide takes a widget off the screen but keeps its place and its content. In Edit layout it shows faded. Right-click it there and choose Show.
help.ledger.close.title: Close a widget
help.ledger.close.body: Right-click a widget and choose Close to take it off the board. An Undo button appears right after. The content stays in the Library.
help.ledger.library.title: Library
help.ledger.library.body: The Library lists the content of every widget, on the board or not. Open it from the tray menu or a widget's right-click menu. Show on board puts an item back.
help.ledger.deleted.title: Recently deleted
help.ledger.deleted.body: Delete in the Library moves an item to Recently deleted. Restore brings it back. Delete permanently removes it for good.
help.ledger.change_type.title: Change widget type
help.ledger.change_type.body: In Edit layout, right-click a widget and choose Change widget type. The new widget takes the same place. The old content stays in the Library.
help.ledger.modes.title: Modes and layouts
help.ledger.modes.body: Timer has three modes: timer, stopwatch and pomodoro. Image has two layouts: slideshow and grid. Right-click the widget and open Mode or Layout to switch.
help.ledger.look.title: Widget appearance
help.ledger.look.body: Right-click a widget and choose Appearance to set its font, colours, opacity and frame. In Edit layout you can also set a background image.
help.ledger.themes.title: Themes
help.ledger.themes.body: Theme colours in the tray menu opens Settings > Appearance. There you set colours, font, corner radius and more for all widgets. Reset to default theme returns to the starting look.
help.ledger.layouts.title: Layouts
help.ledger.layouts.body: Layouts in the tray menu opens Library > Layouts. Apply a built-in or saved layout to rearrange all widgets at once. Save current keeps your arrangement, and Undo last layout change goes back.
help.ledger.focus.title: Focus on one widget
help.ledger.focus.body: Right-click a widget, outside Edit layout, and choose Focus on this widget. Only that widget stays on screen. Choose Leave focus mode or press Esc to bring the rest back.
help.ledger.search.title: Search
help.ledger.search.body: Search in the tray menu or a widget's right-click menu opens the Library with the cursor in the search box. It looks through your memos, diary and calendar.
help.ledger.ai_theme.title: AI themes
help.ledger.ai_theme.body: In Settings > Appearance, AI themes lets an AI chat design your colours. Press Copy AI prompt, describe the look to the AI, then press Paste AI theme and Apply. Undo last theme goes back.
help.ledger.free_placement.title: Free placement
help.ledger.free_placement.body: In Settings > General, set Layout to Free placement to put widgets anywhere, even overlapping. The Layers panel, opened from Edit layout, sets what is in front. Lock position keeps a widget still.
help.ledger.keyboard_mode.title: Keyboard mode
help.ledger.keyboard_mode.body: Choose a Keyboard mode shortcut in Settings > Accessibility. Press it to bring your widgets forward and use them from the keyboard. Tab moves between widgets and Esc leaves.
help.ledger.time_log.title: Shared focus time
help.ledger.time_log.body: Focus time from a Pomodoro counts in the total of every stopwatch set to Focus, even in other widgets. Click the category label on a stopwatch to switch between Focus and Other.
help.ledger.reminders.title: Reminders
help.ledger.reminders.body: Open a calendar entry's details and tick Remind me to get a notification, with an optional lead time in minutes. Settings > Accessibility can also show what is left today at a time you choose.
help.ledger.memo_history.title: Memo history
help.ledger.memo_history.body: Turn on Keep a history of memos in Settings > Widgets. Then open the Library and press History on a memo to see and copy its earlier versions.
help.ledger.backups.title: Backups
help.ledger.backups.body: Settings > Backup & data can back up now or on a daily or weekly schedule. Restore replaces your current data with the backup you pick and restarts the app.
help.ledger.monitors.title: Other monitors
help.ledger.monitors.body: With more than one monitor, open Edit layout, right-click a widget and choose Move to display. Pick the monitor to send it there.
help.guide.checklist.title: Checklist
help.guide.checklist.body: A to-do list with Today, This week and This month tabs. Type a task and press Enter, then click its box to finish it. Right-click to hide or clear finished items.
help.guide.calendar.title: Calendar
help.guide.calendar.body: Keeps your events and to-dos by day. Type an entry like 14:00 Meeting #work to add a time and a tag. The gear on an entry opens its time, repeat, link and reminder settings.
help.guide.calendar.board: Board view shows big squares you can write in. Click a day, type, and press Enter. Right-click and choose Small calendar view to switch.
help.guide.calendar.mini: Mini view shows one month, with dots on days that have entries. Click a day to open its list. Right-click and choose Big squares view to switch.
help.guide.dday.title: D-day
help.guide.dday.body: Counts the days until a date, or since one. Press Add D-day, enter a name and date, and choose Countdown or Anniversary. Click a row to edit it, or drag rows to reorder.
help.guide.memo.title: Memo
help.guide.memo.body: A sticky note that saves as you type. Right-click it to change the note colour.
help.guide.diary.title: Diary
help.guide.diary.body: One page for each day, saved as you type. Use the arrows to move between days, or pick a date.
help.guide.clock.title: Clock
help.guide.clock.body: Shows the time. Right-click it to choose a time zone or show seconds.
help.guide.timer.title: Timer
help.guide.timer.body: One widget with three modes: timer, stopwatch and pomodoro. Right-click it and open Mode to switch. You cannot switch while a mode is running or paused.
help.guide.timer.countdown: Click the digits to type a time such as 25, 1:30 or 1:00:00, then press Start. Scroll over the digits to change it by a minute. Quick-start buttons can be added in Settings > Widgets.
help.guide.timer.stopwatch: The stopwatch counts up and records laps. Its total adds up all time in the same category, Focus or Other. Click the category to switch.
help.guide.timer.pomodoro: The pomodoro alternates focus blocks with short and long breaks. The defaults are 25, 5 and 15 minutes, and Pomodoro settings change them along with the blocks before a long break. Focus time also counts in the total of every focus stopwatch.
help.guide.image.title: Image
help.guide.image.body: Shows your pictures as a slideshow or a grid. Drop images onto it or click it to add them. Right-click and open Layout to switch.
help.guide.image.slideshow: One picture stays still. Several fade into each other. Right-click to set Change every and Shuffle.
help.guide.image.grid: The grid shows all your pictures as tiles. Drag a tile to reorder it. Double-click one to give it a name.
help.guide.showcase.title: Showcase
help.guide.showcase.body: A display card for someone or something you care about, with a name, birthday, photos and rotating quotes. Click the name to set the name and birthday, or right-click and choose Edit. Drop photos onto it to add them.
help.guide.nowplaying.title: Now Playing
help.guide.nowplaying.body: Shows and controls whatever Windows is playing, and can play your own audio files. It works on Windows only.
help.guide.nowplaying.windows: It shows the title and cover of whatever Windows is playing, from a browser or a player such as Spotify. Previous, play and next buttons control it. With several players open, the switch button cycles between them.
help.guide.nowplaying.files: My files plays audio from your own computer. Open it, then add tracks with the plus button or by dropping files. Its header has volume, shuffle and loop.
help.hint.edit_first.title: Edit layout is on
help.hint.edit_first.body: Drag a widget's top strip to move it. Right-click a widget to change its type or open Appearance. Click Done or press Esc to finish.
help.hint.tray_pin.title: WidgetBoard stays in the taskbar
help.hint.tray_pin.body: Right-click its icon to add widgets or edit the layout. Left-click the icon to hide or show every widget. If you don't see it, click ^ on the taskbar and drag the WidgetBoard icon onto the taskbar.
